```{r}
# Clear the workspace and console.
rm(list = ls(all.names = TRUE)) 
cat("\f")

# Library packages
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(rstatix)
library(lsr)
```

```{r}
# read individual subject's csv file and compile
FilesList = list.files(pattern = "\\.csv$")
mergeddata <- data.frame()
for (i in 1:length(FilesList)) {
  fname=FilesList[i]
  subi <- read.csv(fname)
  # "targetloc_real" label in the data file is the true target-distractor location as the grouping changed from trial to trial
  subi <- subset(subi, trials.thisN >= 0, select = c("distractorpresence", "targetloc_real", "search_resp.corr", "search_resp.rt", "participant"))
  mergeddata <- rbind(mergeddata, subi)
}

# rename variables
# "sameobject" label in the data file actually refers to the "same_group" condition
mergeddata$targetloc[mergeddata$targetloc_real == "sameobject"] <- "same_group"
# "otherobject" label in the data file actually refers to the "other_group_near" condition
mergeddata$targetloc[mergeddata$targetloc_real == "otherobject"] <- "other_group_near"
# "far" label in the data file actually refers to the "other_group_far condition"
mergeddata$targetloc[mergeddata$targetloc_real == "far"] <- "other_group_far"
```

```{r}
# Data trimming for individual subject
alldata <- data.frame()

list <- unique(mergeddata$participant)
for (i in list) {

# Create dataframe for the ith subject
distractorpresencei <- mergeddata$distractorpresence[which(mergeddata$participant == i)]
targetloci <- mergeddata$targetloc[which(mergeddata$participant == i)]
searchACCi <- mergeddata$search_resp.corr[which(mergeddata$participant == i)]
searchRTi <- mergeddata$search_resp.rt[which(mergeddata$participant == i)]

# ------------------------------ Trial Trimming ----------------------------------------

# Data trimming
# same group
# cell condition data
same_raw <- ifelse(targetloci == "same_group" & searchACCi == 1, searchRTi, NA)
# means and SDs
same_mean <- mean(same_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
same_sd <- sd(same_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
# trim data
same_trimmed <- ifelse(same_raw > same_mean - 2*same_sd & same_raw < same_mean + 2*same_sd, same_raw, NA)

# other group near
# cell condition data
other_group_near_raw <- ifelse(targetloci == "other_group_near" & searchACCi == 1, searchRTi, NA)
# means and SDs
other_group_near_mean <- mean(other_group_near_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
other_group_near_sd <- sd(other_group_near_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
# trim data
other_group_near_trimmed <- ifelse(other_group_near_raw > other_group_near_mean - 2*other_group_near_sd & other_group_near_raw < other_group_near_mean + 2*other_group_near_sd, other_group_near_raw, NA)

# other group far
# cell condition data
other_group_far_raw <- ifelse(targetloci == "other_group_far" & searchACCi == 1, searchRTi, NA)
# means and SDs
other_group_far_mean <- mean(other_group_far_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
other_group_far_sd <- sd(other_group_far_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
# trim data
other_group_far_trimmed <- ifelse(other_group_far_raw > other_group_far_mean - 2*other_group_far_sd & other_group_far_raw < other_group_far_mean + 2*other_group_far_sd, other_group_far_raw, NA)

# distractor absent
# cell condition data
absence_raw <- ifelse(distractorpresencei == 0 & searchACCi == 1, searchRTi, NA)
# means and SDs
absence_mean <- mean(absence_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
absence_sd <- sd(absence_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
# trim data
absence_trimmed <- ifelse(absence_raw > absence_mean - 2*absence_sd & absence_raw < absence_mean + 2*absence_sd, absence_raw, NA)

# Trial Inclusion
trialinclude <- ifelse(same_trimmed | other_group_near_trimmed | other_group_far_trimmed | absence_trimmed, 1, NA)
# total percentage of trimmed trials
proptrimmed_total <- 1 - sum(trialinclude, na.rm = T)/length(trialinclude)
# the subject's percentage of trials trimmed due to incorrect or absentce of responses
proptrimmed_ACC <- 1 - mean(searchACCi)
# the subject's percentage of trials trimmed due to RT out of 2 SDs
proptrimmed_RT <- proptrimmed_total - proptrimmed_ACC

# Cell mean RT after trimming
same_rt <- mean(same_trimmed, na.rm=TRUE)
other_group_near_rt <- mean(other_group_near_trimmed, na.rm=TRUE)
other_group_far_rt <- mean(other_group_far_trimmed, na.rm=TRUE)
absence_rt <- mean(absence_trimmed, na.rm=TRUE)
presence_rt <- mean(c(same_trimmed, other_group_near_trimmed, other_group_far_trimmed), na.rm=TRUE)
# Cell mean accuracy
same_acc <- mean(searchACCi[which(targetloci == "same_group")])
other_group_near_acc <- mean(searchACCi[which(targetloci == "other_group_near")])
other_group_far_acc <- mean(searchACCi[which(targetloci == "other_group_far")])
absence_acc <- mean(searchACCi[which(distractorpresencei == 0)])
presence_acc <- mean(searchACCi[which(distractorpresencei == 1)])

# create data frame for the ith subject
subID <- i
trialtype <- c('same_group', 'other_group_near', 'other_group_far', 'disabsent', 'dispresent')
RT <- c(same_rt, other_group_near_rt, other_group_far_rt, absence_rt, presence_rt)
ACC <- c(same_acc, other_group_near_acc, other_group_far_acc, absence_acc, presence_acc)
subimean <- data.frame(subID, trialtype, RT, ACC, proptrimmed_RT, proptrimmed_ACC) 
# testing whether the subject meets an overall accuracy of 80% or greater to be included in analyses
subimean$subinclude <- ifelse(mean(searchACCi) > 0.8, 1, 0)

#Add the ith subject's data to a combined data frame
alldata <- rbind(alldata, subimean)
include <- alldata$subID[which(alldata$subinclude == 1)]
# create a new data frame with subjects who failed to meet the accuracy criterion removed
cleandata <- alldata[which(alldata$subID %in% include),]

}

# mean percentage of trials abandoned across subjects
# due to RT out of 2 SDs
mean(cleandata$proptrimmed_RT)
# due to incorrect or absentce of responses
mean(cleandata$proptrimmed_ACC)

# view summary table
cleandata %>% group_by(trialtype) %>% summarise(meanrt = mean(RT), meanacc = mean(ACC))

```

```{r}
# RT plot for all subjects
ggplot(data=cleandata, aes(x=trialtype, y=RT))+
      stat_summary(fun="mean", geom="bar", position=position_dodge())+
      scale_y_continuous(breaks=c(seq(0.58,0.66,0.01))) +
      coord_cartesian( ylim = c(0.58,0.66)) +
      ylab("Reation Time")+ 
      xlab("Trial Type")+ 
      ggtitle("Reaction time as a function of the relative location of target to distractor")

# accuracy plot for all subjects
ggplot(data=cleandata, aes(x=trialtype, y=ACC))+
      stat_summary(fun="mean", geom="bar", position=position_dodge())+
      scale_y_continuous(breaks=c(seq(0.9,1, .02))) +
      coord_cartesian( ylim = c(0.9,1)) +
      ylab("Accuracy")+ 
      xlab("Trial Type")+ 
      ggtitle("Accuracy as a function of the relative location of target to distractor")


```

```{r}
# --------------------------------- Statistical Analysis ----------------------------------
# ***********************RT***********************************
# ANOVA for RT
RT.aov <- anova_test(
  data = cleandata[cleandata$trialtype != "dispresent",], dv = RT, wid = subID,
  within = trialtype, effect.size = "pes"
  )
get_anova_table(RT.aov)

# --------comparing distractor present and absent--------------------

# t-test in RT comparing distractor present and absent
t.test(cleandata$RT[which(cleandata$trialtype == "dispresent" | cleandata$trialtype == "disabsent")] ~ cleandata$trialtype[which(cleandata$trialtype == "dispresent" | cleandata$trialtype == "disabsent")], paired = TRUE) 

cohensD(subset(cleandata,cleandata$trialtype =='disabsent' | cleandata$trialtype=='dispresent')$RT ~ 
         subset(cleandata,cleandata$trialtype =='disabsent' | cleandata$trialtype=='dispresent')$trialtype, method = "paired")

#-------- comparing location conditions to distractor absent--------
# t-test in RT comparing distractor absent and same-group
t.test(cleandata$RT[which(cleandata$trialtype == "same_group" | cleandata$trialtype == "disabsent")] ~ cleandata$trialtype[which(cleandata$trialtype == "same_group" | cleandata$trialtype == "disabsent")], paired = TRUE) 

cohensD(subset(cleandata,cleandata$trialtype =='same_group' | cleandata$trialtype=='disabsent')$RT ~ 
         subset(cleandata,cleandata$trialtype =='same_group' | cleandata$trialtype=='disabsent')$trialtype, method = "paired")

# t-test in RT comparing distractor absent and other_group_near
t.test(cleandata$RT[which(cleandata$trialtype == "other_group_near" | cleandata$trialtype == "disabsent")] ~ cleandata$trialtype[which(cleandata$trialtype == "other_group_near" | cleandata$trialtype == "disabsent")], paired = TRUE) 

cohensD(subset(cleandata,cleandata$trialtype =='other_group_near' | cleandata$trialtype=='disabsent')$RT ~ 
         subset(cleandata,cleandata$trialtype =='other_group_near' | cleandata$trialtype=='disabsent')$trialtype, method = "paired")

# t-test in RT comparing distractor absent and other_group_far
t.test(cleandata$RT[which(cleandata$trialtype == "other_group_far" | cleandata$trialtype == "disabsent")] ~ cleandata$trialtype[which(cleandata$trialtype == "other_group_far" | cleandata$trialtype == "disabsent")], paired = TRUE) 

cohensD(subset(cleandata,cleandata$trialtype =='other_group_far' | cleandata$trialtype=='disabsent')$RT ~ 
         subset(cleandata,cleandata$trialtype =='other_group_far' | cleandata$trialtype=='disabsent')$trialtype, method = "paired")

# --------comparing target-distractor locations--------------------
# t-test in RT comparing same and other_group_near locations
t.test(cleandata$RT[which(cleandata$trialtype == "same_group" | cleandata$trialtype == "other_group_near")] ~ cleandata$trialtype[which(cleandata$trialtype == "same_group" | cleandata$trialtype == "other_group_near")], paired = TRUE) 

cohensD(subset(cleandata,cleandata$trialtype =='same_group' | cleandata$trialtype=='other_group_near')$RT ~ 
         subset(cleandata,cleandata$trialtype =='same_group' | cleandata$trialtype=='other_group_near')$trialtype, method = "paired")

# t-test in RT comparing same and other_group_far locations
t.test(cleandata$RT[which(cleandata$trialtype == "same_group" | cleandata$trialtype == "other_group_far")] ~ cleandata$trialtype[which(cleandata$trialtype == "same_group" | cleandata$trialtype == "other_group_far")], paired = TRUE) 

cohensD(subset(cleandata,cleandata$trialtype =='same_group' | cleandata$trialtype=='other_group_far')$RT ~ 
         subset(cleandata,cleandata$trialtype =='same_group' | cleandata$trialtype=='other_group_far')$trialtype, method = "paired")

# t-test in RT comparing other and other_group_far locations
t.test(cleandata$RT[which(cleandata$trialtype == "other_group_near" | cleandata$trialtype == "other_group_far")] ~ cleandata$trialtype[which(cleandata$trialtype == "other_group_near" | cleandata$trialtype == "other_group_far")], paired = TRUE) 

cohensD(subset(cleandata,cleandata$trialtype =='other_group_near' | cleandata$trialtype=='other_group_far')$RT ~ 
         subset(cleandata,cleandata$trialtype =='other_group_near' | cleandata$trialtype=='other_group_far')$trialtype, method = "paired")

# ***********************Accuracy***********************************
# ANOVA for accuracy
ACC.aov <- anova_test(
  data = cleandata[cleandata$trialtype != "dispresent",], dv = ACC, wid = subID,
  within = trialtype, effect.size = "pes"
  )
get_anova_table(ACC.aov)

# --------comparing distractor present and absent--------------------
# t-test in ACC comparing distractor present and absent
t.test(cleandata$ACC[which(cleandata$trialtype == "dispresent" | cleandata$trialtype == "disabsent")] ~ cleandata$trialtype[which(cleandata$trialtype == "dispresent" | cleandata$trialtype == "disabsent")], paired = TRUE) 

cohensD(subset(cleandata,cleandata$trialtype =='disabsent' | cleandata$trialtype=='dispresent')$ACC ~ 
         subset(cleandata,cleandata$trialtype =='disabsent' | cleandata$trialtype=='dispresent')$trialtype, method = "paired")

#-------- comparing location conditions to distractor absent--------
# t-test in ACC comparing distractor absent and same-group
t.test(cleandata$ACC[which(cleandata$trialtype == "same_group" | cleandata$trialtype == "disabsent")] ~ cleandata$trialtype[which(cleandata$trialtype == "same_group" | cleandata$trialtype == "disabsent")], paired = TRUE) 

cohensD(subset(cleandata,cleandata$trialtype =='same_group' | cleandata$trialtype=='disabsent')$ACC ~ 
         subset(cleandata,cleandata$trialtype =='same_group' | cleandata$trialtype=='disabsent')$trialtype, method = "paired")

# t-test in ACC comparing distractor absent and other_group_near
t.test(cleandata$ACC[which(cleandata$trialtype == "other_group_near" | cleandata$trialtype == "disabsent")] ~ cleandata$trialtype[which(cleandata$trialtype == "other_group_near" | cleandata$trialtype == "disabsent")], paired = TRUE) 

cohensD(subset(cleandata,cleandata$trialtype =='other_group_near' | cleandata$trialtype=='disabsent')$ACC ~ 
         subset(cleandata,cleandata$trialtype =='other_group_near' | cleandata$trialtype=='disabsent')$trialtype, method = "paired")

# t-test in ACC comparing distractor absent and other_group_far
t.test(cleandata$ACC[which(cleandata$trialtype == "other_group_far" | cleandata$trialtype == "disabsent")] ~ cleandata$trialtype[which(cleandata$trialtype == "other_group_far" | cleandata$trialtype == "disabsent")], paired = TRUE) 

cohensD(subset(cleandata,cleandata$trialtype =='other_group_far' | cleandata$trialtype=='disabsent')$ACC ~ 
         subset(cleandata,cleandata$trialtype =='other_group_far' | cleandata$trialtype=='disabsent')$trialtype, method = "paired")

# --------comparing target-distractor locations--------------------
# t-test in ACC comparing same and other-group-near locations
t.test(cleandata$ACC[which(cleandata$trialtype == "same_group" | cleandata$trialtype == "other_group_near")] ~ cleandata$trialtype[which(cleandata$trialtype == "same_group" | cleandata$trialtype == "other_group_near")], paired = TRUE) 

cohensD(subset(cleandata,cleandata$trialtype =='same_group' | cleandata$trialtype=='other_group_near')$ACC ~ 
         subset(cleandata,cleandata$trialtype =='same_group' | cleandata$trialtype=='other_group_near')$trialtype, method = "paired")

# t-test in ACC comparing same and other_group_far locations
t.test(cleandata$ACC[which(cleandata$trialtype == "same_group" | cleandata$trialtype == "other_group_far")] ~ cleandata$trialtype[which(cleandata$trialtype == "same_group" | cleandata$trialtype == "other_group_far")], paired = TRUE) 

cohensD(subset(cleandata,cleandata$trialtype =='same_group' | cleandata$trialtype=='other_group_far')$ACC ~ 
         subset(cleandata,cleandata$trialtype =='same_group' | cleandata$trialtype=='other_group_far')$trialtype, method = "paired")

# t-test in ACC comparing other_group_near and other_group_far locations
t.test(cleandata$ACC[which(cleandata$trialtype == "other_group_near" | cleandata$trialtype == "other_group_far")] ~ cleandata$trialtype[which(cleandata$trialtype == "other_group_near" | cleandata$trialtype == "other_group_far")], paired = TRUE) 

cohensD(subset(cleandata,cleandata$trialtype =='other_group_near' | cleandata$trialtype=='other_group_far')$ACC ~ 
         subset(cleandata,cleandata$trialtype =='other_group_near' | cleandata$trialtype=='other_group_far')$trialtype, method = "paired")
```
